answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 23368 Country: India Title: I have hairs on my chest and around my nipple as well. Hairs around my nipple are very long (size of fingers). can i remove/cut the hairs around my nipple(areola) only? Question: I have hairs on my chest and around my nipple as well. Hairs around my nipple are very long (size of fingers). can i remove/cut the hairs around my nipple(areola) only? Answer ID: 23368 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1015/753/L=1431) It is allowed to remove the hair on chest and around the nipple, but it is better to avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
